summary: Critical Metals Corp. filed a Form 6-K reporting the closing of its Stage 2 acquisition of an additional 50.5% interest in Tanbreez Mining Greenland A/S, increasing its ownership from 42% to 92.5%. Consideration was 14,500,000 ordinary shares issued to Rimbal Pty. Ltd. in a private placement exempt from Section 4(a)(2) of the Securities Act. The remaining 7.5% is held by European Lithium Ltd. The filing also notes a non-binding letter of intent to acquire European Lithium, which would bring ownership to 100%. Completion satisfies the terms of an amended Heads of Agreement, with regulatory approval from the Greenlandic Mineral Resources Authority. Watch for progress on the European Lithium acquisition and advancement of the Tanbreez rare earth project to production.
